definition: Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome (RAMELN; OMIM #621421) is a rare autosomal neurodevelopmental disorder caused by mutations in the transformer 2 beta homolog gene (TRA2B on chromosome 3q27), characterized clinically by severely impaired neurological development, poor growth, microcephaly, hypotonia, and early-onset seizures such as infantile spasms.
